title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Averages
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The average of 6.5, 10.6, 19.7 and a is 12. The value of a is:
questions.explain:
Average $= \frac{\text{Sum of observations}}{\text{Number of observations}}$
$\frac{6.5 + 10.6 + 19.7 + a}{4} = 12$
$36.8 + a = 48$
$a = 48 - 36.8 = 11.2$
